app_info.subtitle: Manage Nango integrations
app_info.description: Nango helps users inspect and manage environments, integrations, connections, syncs, functions, and logs, and run connected actions through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the names and production flags of environments visible to the signed-in user without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads environments within the user's bounded Nango account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches public Nango documentation and returns snippets and links without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries Nango's public documentation service outside the user's private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs supported read-only commands against an isolated virtual copy of the Nango documentation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Nango's public documentation service outside the user's private workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify the documentation sandbox, the Nango server, or the user's computer.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one provider definition and optional function templates without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads Nango's bounded provider catalog and does not contact arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived Connect session, token, and authorization link in the selected Nango environment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates a session only within the user's bounded Nango account and does not itself authorize an external provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing connections, and the new session expires automatically.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists integrations configured in the selected Nango environment without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads integration records from the user's bounded Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one configured integration and optionally its webhook URL or authorized developer-app credentials without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads an integration from the user's bounded Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new integration and stores its configuration and selected developer-app credentials in Nango.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates the record only within the selected Nango environment and does not contact arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Rejects an existing integration ID instead of overwriting it and does not delete other records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates an existing integration's identifier, credentials, webhook forwarding, or configuration in Nango.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only an integration inside the selected Nango environment and does not contact arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite developer-app credentials and integration settings or rename the integration without an automatic undo.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes the selected integration from the Nango environment.
justifications.open_world_justification: Deletes a record only within the user's bounded Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the selected integration and its managed configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists and filters connection records without returning credentials or changing connection state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads connections from the selected Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: May contact a provider to refresh credentials and persist the rotated credential material before returning the connection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can call the connected provider's external authentication endpoints while refreshing credentials.
justifications.destructive_justification: A refresh can overwrite stored access, refresh, or application credential material.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes selected sync schedules between started and paused states.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes sync scheduling state inside the selected Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: The started and paused states are reversible and do not delete synced records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts one or more sync jobs and can request a full reset or removal of existing synced records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Triggered sync jobs can call the external provider APIs configured for the selected connections.
justifications.destructive_justification: The empty_cache option deletes existing synced records before a full sync.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes a customer-configured action that can create or update data and starts another execution when retried.
justifications.open_world_justification: The action can interact with external provider APIs through the selected connection.
justifications.destructive_justification: A customer-defined action can perform irreversible writes or sends in an external provider system.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists deployed syncs, actions, and on-event scripts without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads function metadata from the selected Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deploys a catalog function template and starts the sync for existing connections when the template is a sync.
justifications.open_world_justification: Deploys within the selected Nango environment and only targets connections already configured there rather than arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can deactivate and replace an existing same-named non-catalog function configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the stored status and result of one function deployment without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads a deployment record from the selected Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists and filters stored Nango operation logs without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads logs from the user's selected Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one stored Nango operation and its paginated log messages without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads logs from the user's selected Nango environment.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: List accessible environments before choosing a management target.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the Nango environments I can access so I can choose one before making changes.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the accessible environment names and production flags without querying each environment.

test_cases.description: Create an integration with Nango-provided developer-app credentials.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my dev Nango environment, create a GitHub integration with the ID github using Nango-provided credentials.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the integration and returns its non-secret configuration details.

test_cases.description: Create a restricted Connect authorization session for an end user.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my dev Nango environment, create a Connect authorization link for end user customer-42 that only allows the github integration.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a short-lived authorization link and expiration suitable for sharing with that end user.

test_cases.description: Run a deliberately destructive full sync for one connection.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my dev Nango environment, run a full issues sync for the github connection customer-42 and clear its existing synced records first.
test_cases.expected_output: Triggers the requested full sync with existing-record deletion enabled and reports whether the command was accepted.

test_cases.description: Find recent failed operations for an integration.
test_cases.user_prompt: In my dev Nango environment, show failed operations from the last 24 hours for the github integration.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the newest matching failed operations with pagination information.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Nango to create a provider-side developer application.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new OAuth app for me in the GitHub developer settings.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot create developer applications in provider administration consoles.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use the documentation sandbox to inspect local files.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the files in my computer's home directory.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its filesystem tool only reads the isolated Nango documentation sandbox.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a calendar meeting with my design team tomorrow afternoon.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside its supported workflows.
